summary: Stocks touched fresh record highs Tuesday as AI names led the tape and bond yields retreated. Chipmakers were the standout, with AMD notching new highs on bullish analyst calls.
market_note: S&P futures up 0.68%, gold added 0.95%, and the VIX fell 3% as fear faded.

items.why: Citi hiked its price target to a Street-high $800 from $575, calling AMD the key beneficiary of AI agent demand from Meta's Muse; CEO Lisa Su said the company will substantially increase chip supply in 2027.
The S&P 500 and Nasdaq touched all-time highs as stocks powered higher and bond yields retreated, squeezing the fear gauge lower.
Prime Big Deal Days kicked off (Oct 6-7), and the stock is riding its Sept 30 nuclear power deal with Constellation Energy plus reports of an $8B Nvidia chip financing arrangement.
Melius Research upgraded the stock to Buy from Hold, calling Microsoft the 'adults in charge' of AI, with a $665 target; Scotiabank also raised its target to $615 from $510.
